title: Remove Diagnostics tail target flat export
summary: Removed the Diagnostics parent selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget transitional flat window assignment while preserving the namespace export and regenerated the WebView contract/inventory evidence.
reason: Continue the opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup without changing backend authority, media policy, mutation routes, or Diagnostics behavior.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js assigned window.selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget as a transitional flat compatibility export even though the Diagnostics namespace already exposed selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js exposes selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView only; the flat assignment is absent and the WebView public contract/inventory counts drop by one.
tests_added: Extended tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert the Diagnostics namespace export remains present and the selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget flat assignment is absent.
rollback_plan: Re-add the window.selectedDiagnosticsTailTarget assignment, regenerate the WebView contract/inventory/summaries, and remove the corresponding negative static assertion if an intentional compatibility consumer is discovered.
